name: raelinfo-platform
description: RaelInfo financial utility platform with Cloudflare Pages Functions, D1, Supabase Auth and revenue measurement.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check config.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/revenue.js && node --check public/partner-inquiry.js && node --check public/admin/revenue.js && node --check public/seo-tools.js && node --check public/charts.js && node --check public/crypto.js && node --check public/fx.js && node --check public/news.js && node --check public/filings.js && node --check public/portfolio.js && node --check public/sw.js && node scripts/check-inline-module.mjs && node scripts/check-cloudflare-functions.mjs && node scripts/check-revenue.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler@latest d1 migrations apply raelinfo-production --remote --env production
scripts.db:migrate:list: npx wrangler@latest d1 migrations list raelinfo-production --remote --env production
